name: a drop of water
plain: A picture at true size: a dew drop 2 mm across on the paving, then its surface, which is smooth at every scale down to the molecules. The specks afloat on it (25 nm to 24 µm across, soot to a pollen grain) are drawn from a seed so that something of known size is always in view. Nothing is measured or computed.

carrier.state: a dew drop and the specks on it, drawn at true size

basis.note: 'Every rung is centred on ONE point going in': each finer rung is drawn about the point the coarser one shows at its centre

views.reads: the rung's marks at the zoom's metres per pixel

budget.quantity: what drawing a tile coarse may move against drawing it fine: the draw allocator's tolerance (Acuity, eps_px). It is not a bound on the picture's faithfulness to the holon.
